question: In February 2020, who was appointed the Chairman of the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Supratim Bandyopadhyay.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Supratim Bandyopadhyay **was chosen to lead the **Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority,** which is responsible for promoting and developing a structured** pension system to sustainably meet the demands** of those in need of income in their senior years.
 
• Employees of the **Government of India**, State Governments, private institutions/organizations, and **unorganised sectors** can subscribe to **NPS under PFRDA regulation.**
 
• **Around $3 trillion in total is held **and managed by** public pension funds**. These assets are held in trust for more than** 15 million active state and local government employees**, as well as for more than 8 million retired public employees and their surviving family members. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Pension funds are collections of monetary **contributions from pension plans established by employers, unions, or other groups to cover the** retirement benefits** of their members or employees.
 
• In most nations,** pension funds** are the biggest investors and control the stock markets in which they participate.
 
• **Pension funds are financial instruments **that assist you in saving money for the years after retirement.
